# For AI agents

`aw_agents` ships artifacts for coding agents alongside its code. This page lists
them, says where each lives in the repository, and points at the
machine-readable copies of this documentation.

## Skills

Skills are folders holding a `SKILL.md` (the [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) format): a description that tells an agent when to use it and a body with the procedure. Install one into your agent with `gh skill` (any host: `--agent claude-code`, `copilot`, `cursor`, `codex`, `gemini`), or use the copy bundled in the wheel.

### `aw-agents`

Use the aw_agents package: download content from a URL with landing-page detection and context-aware file names (DownloadAgent, DownloadEngine, download_content), serve an agent to Claude as an MCP server or to ChatGPT as an OpenAPI/FastAPI service, and write a new agent once for both (AgentBase, create_json_schema, MCPAdapter, OpenAPIAdapter). Use when someone wants to “download this dataset/paper/PDF”, “find the real download link behind a landing page”, “serve an agent to Claude Desktop”, “make a ChatGPT custom GPT action from an agent”, or “write an agent for both Claude and ChatGPT” with aw_agents.

```bash
gh skill install addaix/aw_agents aw-agents --agent claude-code
```

Source: [`aw_agents/data/skills/aw-agents`](https://github.com/addaix/aw_agents/tree/HEAD/aw_agents/data/skills/aw-agents) (bundled with the pip package).

### `aw-agents-dev`

Develop and maintain the aw_agents package: its layout (AgentBase, the MCP and OpenAPI adapters, the download agent and its engine), adding an agent or an adapter, running the tests, and releasing through wads CI. Use when changing aw_agents’ code, adding an agent under aw_agents/agents/, adding a platform adapter, fixing the download engine’s landing-page or extension handling, or cutting a release.

```bash
gh skill install addaix/aw_agents aw-agents-dev --agent claude-code
```

Source: [`aw_agents/data/skills/aw-agents-dev`](https://github.com/addaix/aw_agents/tree/HEAD/aw_agents/data/skills/aw-agents-dev) (bundled with the pip package).

The bundled skills are also on disk after `pip install aw_agents`, under the package’s `data/skills/` directory; link them into an agent without network access with `skill link-skills <that directory>`.

## Machine-readable documentation

This site publishes the same documentation in forms that fit an agent’s context window:

- [`llms.txt`](https://addaix.github.io/aw_agents/llms.txt): an index of every page with a one-line description ([llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org) format)
- [`aw_agents.md`](https://addaix.github.io/aw_agents/aw_agents.md): the whole documentation as one Markdown file
- `<page>.html.md`: a rendered Markdown twin of every page, advertised from each page’s `<head>` with `<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">`
- [`objects.inv`](https://addaix.github.io/aw_agents/objects.inv): the Sphinx inventory: a symbol-to-URL index (`sphobjinv convert plain objects.inv -`)
